description: Write whole text files (new, overwrite, or append) and create empty directories, with missing parents. Use when you have full content or need folders. Do not use it for partial edits; use `edit`, `replace_text`, or `patch` instead, and `move` to copy or rename. Whole-file writes are atomic (temp file, then rename); appends are not. An existing file is replaced only with overwrite: true or after one user confirmation for the batch; nothing is written before the answer. Declined entries fail with CANCELLED; skipped ones land in skipped. Entries fail alone; the call errors only when all fail. Returns files (path, size, lineCount, mimeType, kind, resourceUri, created, modified), directories, failures, skipped, and an undo id for `undo` (30 min), or undoUnavailable.

directories.description: Empty directories, created recursively; an existing directory succeeds; a path also listed in files is rejected.

items.description: File or directory path inside an allowed workspace root.

files.description: Files to write. Give files, directories, or both. Combined content per call is at most FS_MAX_FILE_SIZE (default 10 MiB).

append.description: Add content to the end, adding no newline; creates a missing file. Never asks; wins over overwrite. lineCount is 0 past FS_MAX_FILE_SIZE.

content.description: Full text to write, verbatim, as UTF-8.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file without asking. Without it, a client that cannot show the prompt fails the whole call with INVALID_INPUT.

path.description: Absolute file path inside a writable root; one entry per file.

name: create
title: Create Files
